name: io.github.SharafThawfeek/axiom-debug
description: Recall how your team already fixed this build failure, from a private per-project index.

environmentVariables.name: AXIOM_MEMORY_URL
environmentVariables.description: SQLAlchemy URL for failure memory. Defaults to a local SQLite file under ~/.axiom-debug; set this to share memory across a team via Postgres.

environmentVariables.name: AXIOM_PROJECT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Pins the project scope. Defaults to a hash of the git remote, so every clone of a repository shares one memory. Set it to split a monorepo.

environmentVariables.name: AXIOM_CORPUS_URL
environmentVariables.description: Postgres+pgvector URL for the optional public OSS incident corpus. Unset means the corpus tools are not registered at all.

environmentVariables.name: AXIOM_ENABLE_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Opt in to the LLM-backed analyze_failure tool. Off by default: every other tool answers in milliseconds with no model call.
